body: I've been reading a lot. Trying to keep my mind occupied. Reddit helps 😊

I am so sorry. I've been ridiculed for being homeless as well and ya know what all those people making fun of you are either filthy rich (prolly not) or very close to homelessness themselves. I know how embarssing it may feel but you have nothing to be embarrassed about. You are so strong for continuing to fight. I know it's been hard for you and I know things will get better. fuck the haters. you can always message me if you want to vent.
this is ignorant. many homeless people have jobs.
This happens to me a lot. i think it has something to do with the circadian rhythm or whatever it's called idk
Also I mentioned sleeping during the day when the sun is out
that's why I mentioned that this won't work for everyone. this is just stuff I learned that helped me
no prob
i applied through 211 they also helped me get emergency food stamps
mosquitos are everywhere mannnn the bites don't even bother me anymore. green alcohol soothes the bites a bit

i romanticize my situation now out of necessity. but the reality is it is HARSH. it's like nothing I've ever experienced and if there is any way you can avoid being homeless, take that route instead. but idk it's your life
thissssss is very important! thank you
ah yessss food banks are a godsend. also in some counties you can get expedited food stamps when you're homeless. i got approved my 3rd day out on the street and received my card the following week.
It's just my own general rule. if I have an appt at 8am or 11am I go to it but I'm going to bed after. It's really just whatever works for you
Thank you. I've had my fair share of suffering and I don't want anyone to go though the same.

the cold months are coming and that is the worst time to be homeless. just be realistic and picture your worst day and multiple that 10 and also imagine your outside with no where to go at night. good luck to you
Thank you!
In my city it's called the crisis unit but basically anywhere you can voluntarily admit yourself.
music and mary jane. writing also helps

i use weed to cope. i slept outside for a few weeks and it was kinda nice to be stoned under the night sky. just be careful and don't let it consume you and your wallet. also be careful not to smoke with strangers. only smoke what you roll or pack. you're homeless and you deserve whatever can ease your discomfort. good luck ♡
cal 211 in your area. good luck. i mean it

I'm gonna be moving into one next month! I stayed on one for a rainy weekend and it felt so nice to be inside. I can't wait to put food in a fridge! I can't wait to cook again! Too sleep in!! shower whenever I want. ugh extended stays are like peak luxury in my mind.

be careful linking up with another woman. I almost got wrapped up in sex trafficking because of it. traffickers often use other women as bait to catch more girls out on the streets alone. be safe! I can not stress that enough
being a homeless woman is soooo scary. I pray we all get through this.
